The Digne Cathedral (Saint‑Jérôme Cathedral) sits in the commune of Digne‑les‑Bains, which is part of the **arrondissement of Digne‑les‑Bains**.  
That arrondissement is located within the **Alpes‑de‑Haute‑Provence** department (in the Provence‑Alpes‑Côte d’Azur region).
